Application received for the post of Dietician, Dental X-Ray Assistant, Cook, Attendant have been scrutinized.
Basis on the recommendation of the Scrutiny following application have been found to be eligible in accordance with the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the advertisement.
The written exam for the following post shall be held on 16
th
March, 2024 at 10.00 AM in the Center Examination Hall, MGIMS, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha.  No travel expenses shall be reimbursed.
Please find the list below:
Dental X-Ray Assistant
Attendant
Cook
Dietician
